item.title: Two of Ring’s latest video doorbells are a lot cheaper than usual
item.summary: Ring’s Wired Doorbell Pro and Battery Doorbell Plus are two of the brand’s most well-rounded video doorbells, whether you’re looking for a hardwired model or one that runs on a battery.
